description:
These fish scale tiles for bathroom walls are glazed ceramic mosaic pieces in a teal blue glaze, shaped like overlapping scales (also called scallop or mermaid tiles) for walls and shower niches.

## How they look
The curved, overlapping shape gives a wall soft movement that straight-edged tiles cannot, and the teal glaze shifts between blue and green as the light changes. It is a decorative tile, best used where you want people to notice the wall.

## Where they work
- **One feature wall** behind the basin or bathtub.
- **Shower niches and the band at eye level** in a shower.
- **Powder rooms and guest washrooms**, where a small area can carry a bold pattern.

Keep the other walls plain so the scales stand out, and use it on walls rather than floors.

## Good to know
Fish scale tiles need a careful setter: the rows must stay level for the scallops to line up, and the top edge needs planning where the pattern stops. A white grout outlines each scale; a matching teal or grey grout gives a smoother, more even look.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour in your bathroom light, then get a dated quote. More shapes are in the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic).

faqs.q: What is the price of fish scale tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can fish scale tiles be used on a bathroom floor?
faqs.a: They are mainly a wall tile. For floors, a flatter mosaic such as hexagon or penny round is usually a safer choice. Ask Pak Clay which of its mosaics suit floors.

faqs.q: Fish scale or hexagon mosaic: which is better for a bathroom?
faqs.a: Fish scale is more decorative and suits one feature wall; hexagon is more versatile and works on floors and walls. Many bathrooms use one of each: hexagon on the floor and fish scale on a feature wall.
